statements.quote: On the capex side, we feel that the capex number, where a lot of capex in our existing business has already been front‑ended.
statements.target: Capex FY27 remains largely front‑ended; no additional major spend beyond the existing 1,058 cr already executed.

statements.quote: Construction of our 1 million square feet facility in Noida ... is nearing completion, and we expect the operation to commence by Q2 this fiscal.
statements.target: Commence operation of 1 M sq‑ft Noida facility in Q2 FY27, adding higher capacity for anchor customers.

statements.quote: We are targeting almost INR56,000 crores without the Vivo numbers, and mobile volume being flat.
statements.target: FY27 revenue target of ~₹56 k crore (excluding Vivo), with mobile volume flat.

statements.quote: If Vivo comes in, then it's a very major trigger. We feel that without the Vivo also, the company will keep growing at almost 15% to 17%.
statements.target: Expect 15–17% growth FY27; Vivo arrival could significantly lift revenue.

statements.quote: We will be expanding the capacities of camera module and a subsidiary Q Tech, from 70 million units annually to around 180 million units to 190 million units annually over the next 15 to 18 months.
statements.target: Increase camera module & Q Tech capacity to 180–190 m units annually within 15–18 months.

statements.quote: We expect a high‑double‑digit growth quarter‑on‑quarter in the smartphones volume along with growth in selling prices by 12% to 15%.
statements.target: High‑double‑digit Q‑o‑Q smartphone volume growth in FY27, with 12–15% price uplift.

statements.quote: On the feature phone side, there's a significant upside because we're going to be starting exports of feature phones under our subsidiary Ismartu to Africa. So that number will take us up to almost 50 million units.
statements.target: Feature phone exports via Ismartu to Africa to reach ~50 m units FY27.

statements.quote: The other triggers of growth, the telecom network business is doing extremely well. We have grown from INR3,600 crores to INR5,000 crores in the current fiscal. We are targeting almost INR7,500 crores, INR8,000 crores in '26, '27.
statements.target: Telecom & networking revenue target of ₹7.5–8 k crore FY27.
